caption: Default policy on a clear line: the Auto connection gets the smooth direct S-bend immediately — no grid staircase, no A* run.
Same layout with the new Settings toggle off: the connection is routed by the classic A* grid search instead of the direct styled geometry.
A component dropped across the styled path: the direct candidate is rejected against the obstacle grid and A* automatically routes around it.
Settings → Routing: the new 'Direct routes first' escape hatch sits above the diagonal option, on by default, with a description of the A*-fallback behavior.
